scenes.description: A razor line of light crawls over the brushed metal cap of the bottle.

shot.lighting: hard rim light from camera-right, deep black surroundings, soft low fill
shot.composition: the cap of the bottle fills the frame edge to edge
shot.subject_action: A thin band of hard light slides slowly across the brushed metal cap of the bottle.

scenes.description: A single water drop lands on a dark leaf.

shot.composition: the leaf fills the lower half against a black void
shot.subject_action: A single water drop falls onto a dark leaf in extreme slow motion.

scenes.description: Rim light traces the faceted glass edge of the bottle.

shot.lighting: hard rim light from camera-right, deep black surroundings, soft low fill
shot.composition: the glass edge of the bottle runs diagonally across the frame
shot.subject_action: Rim light traces the faceted glass edge of the bottle as the camera pushes in.

scenes.description: Cold droplets bead on the glass of the bottle.

shot.lighting: hard rim light from camera-right, deep black surroundings, soft low fill
shot.composition: droplets cover the glass of the bottle, sharp in the centre
shot.subject_action: Fine droplets bead on the cold glass of the bottle and run down slowly.

scenes.description: The bottle, cap off, releases one fine horizontal plume of mist from its nozzle.

shot.lighting: single hard backlight behind the mist, black void
shot.composition: the bottle in profile on the left third, the plume of mist crossing to the right against black
shot.subject_action: The bottle, cap off, releases one fine horizontal plume of mist from its nozzle to the right.

scenes.description: The bottle sinks into still black water in a column of bubbles.

shot.lighting: hard rim light from camera-right, deep black surroundings, soft low fill
shot.composition: the bottle centred, bubbles rising around it
shot.subject_action: The bottle sinks into still black water in slow motion, sending up a column of bubbles.

scenes.description: A slow orbit catches a glint on the bottle on wet dark rock.

shot.lighting: a cold rim light from camera-right, a warm glint on one facet
shot.composition: the bottle on wet rock, slightly low angle
shot.subject_action: A slow 30-degree orbit around the bottle; a highlight travels over its facets.

scenes.description: A hand in a white thobe cuff sets the bottle down on dark stone.

shot.lighting: hard rim light from camera-right, deep black surroundings, soft low fill
shot.composition: the hand and cuff enter from the right; only the wrist and fingers in frame
shot.subject_action: A hand in a white thobe cuff sets the bottle down on dark stone.

scenes.description: Hero: the bottle on wet black rock under a hard rim light.

shot.lighting: hard rim light from camera-right, deep black surroundings, soft low fill
shot.composition: the bottle centred, lower fifth of the frame clear for the end card
shot.subject_action: The camera pushes in slowly on the bottle on wet black rock.
